# govengers/typst

> Render PDF, SVG and PNG from Typst templates in Go services through the typst CLI: one process per Compile in a fresh directory (project root, data as data.json, no network, empty environment), timeout and output cap, version check at New. Escape, Quote and FromMarkdown keep user text data. Observer with prometheusadapter and oteladapter.

- Module: `github.com/govengers/typst`, Go 1.26, Apache 2.0. Needs a typst binary >= 0.13.0 (MinimumVersion); tested on 0.15.1.
- `typst.New(&typst.Options{Binary, Version, FontPaths, SystemFonts, PackagePath, TemporaryDirectory, Timeout, MaximumOutputSize, Observers})` resolves the binary, runs `--version`; fails on a missing binary, an old or (with Version) different release, a missing font or package directory. Defaults: Binary "typst" from PATH, Timeout 30 s, MaximumOutputSize 64 MiB, system fonts off.
- `compiler.Compile(ctx, &typst.Document{Name, Source, Data, Files, Format, Page, PixelsPerInch}) ([]byte, error)`. Source is written as main.typ, Data (encoding/json) as data.json, Files by slash path (fs.ValidPath, no backslash, not main.typ/data.json). The template reads `json("/data.json")`. Format pdf (default, all pages), svg or png (one page: Page from 1, zero means first). PixelsPerInch only for png.
- Errors: ErrInvalidDocument (nothing ran), *CompileError{ExitCode, Diagnostics} via errors.As (Error() = first error line, e.g. "main.typ:2:1: error: unknown variable: x"), ErrTimeout, ErrOutputTooLarge, ErrPageNotFound (image page beyond the document), wrapped ctx error. Diagnostics can quote data; log them like data.
- User text: prefer Data and `#data.field` (content, never markup). User Markdown: `typst.FromMarkdown(s)` (CommonMark + GFM tables, strikethrough, task lists, bare links; output only escaped text and calls; links http/https/mailto only; HTML stays text; images become alt text), pass as data, render with `#eval(data.field, mode: "markup")`. Go-string templates: `typst.Escape(s)` (markup), `typst.Quote(s)` (string literal with quotes).
- Isolation: --root is the render dir's project/, packages only from Options.PackagePath (<namespace>/<name>/<version>), downloads blocked through proxy variables to 127.0.0.1:0, fresh package cache per compile, directory removed before Compile returns.
- Observer: CompileStarted(ctx, *Compile) ctx, CompileFinished(ctx, *Compile, *Outcome{Result, Duration, OutputSize, Err}). Results: success, compile_error, timeout, output_too_large, cancelled, failure. `prometheusadapter.New(&Options{Registerer, Namespace})`: <ns>_typst_compiles_total{name,format,result}, <ns>_typst_compile_duration_seconds{name,format}, <ns>_typst_output_bytes{format}. `oteladapter.New(&Options{TracerProvider})`: span typst.compile with typst.name/format/result/output_bytes, no error text.
- Image: copy the static musl typst release into the runtime image (docs/wiki/Home.md); vendor packages and fonts into the image; set Options.Version to the copied release.
- Tests: unit tests use the test binary as a fake typst (no typst needed, ~2 s); `just test-e2e` installs typst 0.15.1 into sandbox/typst (sha256 checked) and runs test/e2e with the e2e tag.
- Standards: govengers/standards `library` profile.

- [test/e2e/typst_test.go](test/e2e/typst_test.go): every format, isolation and escaping against the real typst.
